pageDescription: Connect your store to your own domain (e.g. store.com) to strengthen your brand and gain customer trust.
step1Title: What do you need to get started?
domainRegisteredDesc: You must have purchased the domain from a provider like GoDaddy or Namecheap.
dnsAccessDesc: You must have permission to edit the DNS records of the domain.
dnsStepDesc: Go to your domain control panel and add the following record to direct visitors to your store:
dnsNote: Note: DNS changes may take 5 minutes to 24 hours to propagate worldwide. We recommend using Cloudflare for faster updates and better security.
dnsVerifiedDesc: {{domain}} has been connected to your store successfully. It may take some time for the SSL certificate to activate.
whyList2: Makes it easy for customers to remember your store URL
whyList3: Improves your store's search engine ranking (SEO)
whyList4: Provides a clean short link for sharing on social media
faq1q: Do I need to pay extra fees?
faq1a: No, the platform provides custom domain support and SSL certificates for free within your plan.
faq2q: What if I want to use a subdomain?
faq2a: You can connect `shop.example.com` the same way by changing the Host in the CNAME record.
domainFormatError: Invalid domain format. Must be like: example.com or www.example.com
domainUpdateError: An error occurred while updating the domain
dnsVerifyError: An error occurred while contacting the server to verify DNS
